voice-branch-jargon.notes: Fixed. The workstream label is gone in all three places: "the open content of R2-core" -> "what remains open"; "this closes R2-core's unit" -> "this fixes the unit"; "a derivation closes R2-core's unit; a refutation removes the lead" -> "a derivation would fix the unit; a refutation would rule the identification out", which also drops the tracked-lead framing and the unresolvable "of the same species as R2 itself". The dated heading "(bar-parity, 2026-07-25)" -> "(bar-parity)". "enters the corpus only formally" -> "enters this paper only formally". "recorded ... in the exploration witness" -> "verified exactly at orders $n = 1$ through $6$". Audit-tier vocabulary: "at measured tier" -> "as measured", and "promote the $u \equiv 1$ alignment from measured to derived" -> "derive the $u \equiv 1$ alignment that is at present only measured", which keeps the admission that it is measured and not derived. "data-blind on the current corpus" -> "data-blind on the data available here". Separately, the "keystone" honorific on the normalizer identity is replaced by plain description. Every number, hedge and open-content statement is unchanged.
